notes:
- **New: Sounds**: every sound your mod needs in one place - each mob's ambient, hurt, death and step sounds and every sound event in your code. New mobs and sounds appear automatically with fitting Minecraft sounds (a zombie-like mob gets zombie sounds, a golem gets golem sounds), so nothing is silent. Listen to all 1,968 Minecraft sounds - any sound that isn't on your PC yet is fetched from Minecraft's servers in a moment. Shape each sound with **Tone & speed**, **Loudness**, **Carries** (how far it's heard), **Plays how often** and **Variation**, or one-click styles like Heavy, Giant or Small & quick. Import your own .ogg, then **Connect sounds to the code**.
- **Shortcuts in order**: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 now follow the sidebar from top to bottom (Assistant, Files & Code, 3D Studio, Texture Studio, Sounds, Recipes & Loot, Particles, Build & Run, Version Converter).
- **New: Recipes & Loot**: a visual crafting table - shaped, shapeless, furnace, blast furnace, smoker, campfire and stonecutter recipes - and a loot-table builder for your blocks (drops itself, drops items, ore with Silk Touch and Fortune) and mobs (counts, chances, Looting, player kills). Your mod's items are listed first, then every Minecraft item with its icon. Files are written in the exact format of your Minecraft version, and no code is needed.
- **New in the 3D Studio: weapons, tools, guns and armor**: switch between **Mob**, **Weapon / tool / gun** and **Armor set**. Describe a weapon or gun and get a 3D item model with a starter texture and positions set for the hand, first person, the inventory, the ground and item frames - check each on a player mannequin and fine-tune them live. From Minecraft 1.21.4 the inventory can keep the flat icon. Armor sets get a GeckoLib 3D armor model shown on the mannequin and **Connect to code** for the armor renderer.
- **New: Particles**: design particles, sword-swing trails, shockwave rings, spiral vortexes, auras and explosions with a live preview - shape, sprite (star, orb, slash, smoke, rune, spark or your own), colour and opacity fades, size, lifetime, speed, spread, gravity and glow. Save writes the particle files; **Connect to code** registers the particle and spawns it on your item, mob or projectile.
- **Server settings**: Build & Run has **Server settings** for the test server - the addresses to join (this PC and your network), port, allow offline players, admins, players, game mode, difficulty and rules. The Minecraft EULA is asked once, and you agree to it yourself.
- **3D Studio on Minecraft 26.x**: projects on the new year-based versions (like NeoForge 26.3) now get the right GeckoLib release (5.5.x), so models and animations can be generated. The badge says clearly when GeckoLib exists for your version and checks for new releases by itself.
- **New animations without starting over**: ask for one - "make a bow aiming animation", "add a waving pose" - in the 3D Studio (or simply in the Assistant chat) and it is added to the mob's animations, with the object it needs (like a bow) built into the model. The model and every other animation stay as they are. There is also an **Add as a new animation** button.
- **Effects in the 3D Studio**: glowing eyes, fire, smoke, soul flames, sparkles, dust when walking, hearts and drips play live around your mob. Press **Add the effects in game** (or Connect) and the Assistant adds them to the mob's code - glowing eyes use GeckoLib's glow layer.
- **Generate textures one after another**: while a texture is being painted you can open any other asset - it shows only its own status, and pressing Generate there puts it in line; it starts by itself as soon as the current one is finished.
- **Build and Run Mod open Build & Run**: the build log and the game are right in front of you.
- **See what the Assistant is doing**: instead of "Planning the changes", the chat shows the real steps live - what it is planning and which file it is writing right now ("Writing ArenaZombie.java - file 3").
- **Always continue**: big requests are built in parts. Press **Always continue** on the Next steps card (or turn it on in Settings > Assistant) and each next part starts by itself as soon as the current one compiles.
- **Edits that didn't match are re-applied by themselves**: when an edit was written against an older version of a file, the app gives the Assistant the file's current content and the change is applied again - no more "PATCH_FAILED" messages.
- **Generate textures right in the Texture Studio**: Generate now paints in place with a live progress box (what MyPixelAI is doing and how long it has taken), and the new **Detail** choice (Fast, Normal, Max) is on the Generate card.
- **Show GUI buttons**: for a GUI texture, a new button at the top of the Texture Studio outlines every slot, button, text field and progress bar exactly where your mod's code draws them - and MyPixelAI paints GUIs to that layout.
- **Every asset comes with a professional art brief**: the Assistant now describes each item, block, GUI and mob it creates. The description is ready in the Texture Studio's "Describe the texture" and in the 3D Studio's "Look & motion" - just press Generate.
- **Fixed: mob arms and legs invisible**: a mob texture painted in the classic skin layout didn't match its 3D model's UV map, so some parts read empty pixels. Textures are now laid onto the model's own UV map when you save or generate them, and the 3D Studio warns about a mismatch with a one-click **Fit texture to the model**.
- **Paste pictures with Ctrl+V**: paste a screenshot or a copied image straight into the Assistant chat (it is attached to your message), the Texture Studio's description box or the MyPixelAI page (it becomes a reference picture).
- **3D asset pictures that stay current**: mobs in the asset lists are shown as their 3D model and blocks as a small cube, and a picture updates as soon as you save a new texture or model. Mobs have their own MOBS section.
- **"Error loading mods" is caught**: if Minecraft stops on its "Error loading mods" screen while you test, the app notices it, closes the game and has the Assistant fix the cause (or offers a Fix it button).
- **Smarter repairs on the newest Minecraft versions**: when code doesn't compile, the app now looks the failing names up in your Minecraft version's own files - where a class moved, what it was renamed to, which methods really exist - and gives the AI those exact names, so repairs on brand-new versions (like 26.x) stop guessing.
- **Next parts wait their turn**: for a big request, "Continue with the next part" now appears only after the current part has been compiled and repaired - not while it is still being fixed.
- **No more black console windows**: builds, exports, test servers and checks run quietly inside the app.
- **Export shows how long it takes**: an estimate before you start and a live timer while the .jar is built.
- **Clearer usage**: the console and Build & Run show only tokens (no prices). The usage card shows just your tokens; on plans without a limit there is no countdown, and renewals are shown as a plain date in your own time.
